wholePhysicalScope: Mapped 37-vertex building envelope and 18 building-part outlines, including the Cloud, tower, limestone galleries and roots.
lodDetails: Four levels retain the roots, limestone galleries, curved Cloud and 100-metre Tower of Hope. Near levels add glass seams and the tower lattice.
limitations: The dated exterior reflects April 2014. The October 2012 photograph also informs the permanent curved glass and tower. The temporary opening sign, construction equipment and surrounding landscape are excluded.
The named overall outline and mapped parts fix the roots, galleries and tower in plan. The detailed curves, changing glass panel sizes, lattice, roof joins and slopes are simplified and approximate.
The museum’s published 100-metre tower height sets the overall height. Original independent terrain is preserved. The approximate terrain datum is referenced to the south approach.
